exposure: birth weight as a percentile of the Fenton curve
cohort: The study participants were singleton, non-small for gestational age (non-SGA) very preterm infants (VPIs) in China.
finding: Several factors, including later addition of human milk fortifier, longer duration of parenteral nutrition, and moderate/severe bronchopulmonary dysplasia, were identified as risk factors for EUGR, while full-course antenatal steroids and breastfeeding initiation were protective.
gest_age: Less than 32 weeks (classified into groups: <28 weeks, 28-28+6 weeks, 29-29+6 weeks, 30-30+6 weeks, 31-31+6 weeks)
